blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines unloaded a fourth quarter masterclass to score a 69-67 come-from-behind win over Adamson in the UAAP Season 88 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday. After trailing for most of the game, the Fighting Maroons used the payoff period to follow up on their victory over La Salle last Sunday. “At the half, the coaches talked to us and really told us that we needed to regroup and do the things we needed to do. That really woke us up,” UP star Rey Remogat said. […]... Keep on reading: UAAP: UP turns tables on Adamson for second straight win
